title: Sing When You're Winning — Boundary-Localized SOURCE → WORLD → RECEIPT Scoring

purpose.primary_question: Does the Robbie Williams Sing When You're Winning composition exhibit a rare conjunction of same-source multiplicity, one coherent external world, and one unique external receipt, rather than merely a high aggregate semantic similarity score?
why_this_is_done: Localize the first structural boundary at which candidate and control images diverge.
Separate identity multiplicity from world multiplicity and external-outcome multiplicity.
Prevent a strong score on one dimension from masking failure on another dimension.
Distinguish true structural convergence from post-hoc semantic fitting.
Create a preregisterable, machine-readable endpoint for the 100–200 image blind-control program.
Make adversarial controls such as Deadpool diagnostically useful rather than merely similar examples.
non_claims: This protocol does not establish causal, retrocausal, supernatural, predictive, or intentional influence between the 2000 artwork and JANUS.
A high score is not a probability of anomaly.
A semantic match is not evidence of historical provenance.
Exploratory pilot observations must not be silently converted into confirmatory evidence.

interpretation.SOURCE: Whether multiple visible instances are attributable to one underlying identity, lineage, source, or representational origin rather than merely different subjects of the same class.
interpretation.WORLD: Whether those instances coexist within one coherent external world, scene, causal environment, or reality rather than being explicitly distributed across distinct worlds, timelines, universes, or incompatible environments.
interpretation.RECEIPT: Whether the composition contains one salient external event, object, achievement, transaction, outcome, or other world-level consequence whose cardinality remains one despite internal multiplicity.

core_model.cardinality_rule: Internal representational multiplicity may increase without implying proportional multiplication of external-world events or receipts.

identity_boundary.question: Are the apparent multiple instances actually attributable to the same underlying source?
examples: single-character variants when provenance is explicitly shared
identity_boundary.common_false_positive: Ordinary ensemble images containing many different people.

world_boundary.question: Do the source-instances occupy one coherent external world?
world_boundary.adversarial_example: Deadpool multiverse variants: same character lineage but multiple universes/worlds.

receipt_boundary.question: Does one unique external consequence/object/event remain singular despite internal multiplicity?
receipt_boundary.common_false_positive: Several visually similar objects or several independent outcomes presented in one collage.

algorithm: If SOURCE fails, set first_break=SOURCE and do not infer WORLD or RECEIPT from the aggregate score.
If SOURCE and WORLD pass, evaluate RECEIPT.
If all three pass, set first_break=NONE and structural_pattern=FULL_CHAIN.
first_break_rule.reason: The first failed boundary is more diagnostically informative than a single aggregate semantic score because it identifies which structural condition prevents the candidate from reproducing the target pattern.

machine_readable_record.missing_data_policy: Use null and UNDETERMINED rather than guessing.

aggregate_metrics.important_comparison: Compare the target image against controls by boundary profile, not only total score.

clone_photo.expected_profile: SOURCE may pass; WORLD may pass; RECEIPT often absent
clone_photo.purpose: Tests whether self-multiplicity alone explains the target.

deadpool_multiverse.purpose: Tests whether same-source multiplicity plus explicit variant structure is sufficient without one-world continuity.

fifa_or_championship.purpose: Tests whether football, victory, and a unique trophy alone explain the target.

multiple_receipts.purpose: Tests whether the one-receipt constraint is genuinely discriminative.

where_applicable.computer_vision: Detect whether apparent multiplicity represents one source, one scene, and one external outcome.
where_applicable.distributed_systems: Map many replicas/views to one external transaction, lock, payment, reservation, or world-state commit.
where_applicable.multi_agent_ai: Prevent multiple runtime views or forks of one lineage from being interpreted as multiple independent external commitments.
where_applicable.identity_and_authority: Separate number of representations from number of independent identities, votes, permissions, debts, or ownership claims.
where_applicable.version_control_and_data_lineage: Distinguish branches/views of one history from independent histories and prevent internal branching from duplicating external events.
where_applicable.games_and_simulations: Distinguish multiple visual/client representations of one entity from multiple server-authoritative entities or world events.
where_applicable.financial_and_transaction_systems: Model many internal attempts or replicas against one externally valid transaction receipt.
where_applicable.database_replication: Ensure replicated internal state does not create multiple external side effects.
where_applicable.causal_graph_analysis: Separate representational multiplicity from multiplication of causal world events.
where_applicable.media_and_visual_semantics: Quantify whether a visual composition encodes one-source multiplicity, world continuity, and singular external outcome simultaneously.

why_deadpool_matters.diagnostic_value: Deadpool-style multiverse material can pass the identity-multiplicity condition while deliberately failing the one-world condition.
why_deadpool_matters.consequence: It prevents the experiment from treating every multi-instance character composition as equivalent to the Robbie pattern.

application_to_robbie.candidate: Sing When You're Winning album artwork, 2000
application_to_robbie.required_next_test: blind randomized 100–200 image control with 2–3 independent raters and preregistered scoring

experimental_design.separation_of_roles: Image retrieval, randomization, scoring, and unblinding should be separated whenever practical.
exclusion: Near-duplicate variants unless explicitly assigned to a control stratum
Images whose source cannot be verified after scoring
experimental_design.pilot_policy: The previous 44-image and 58-image exploratory sets remain exploratory and must not be silently pooled into the confirmatory endpoint.

decision_logic.supportive_pattern: Target has FULL_CHAIN while the blind control distribution shows substantially lower FULL_CHAIN prevalence and no comparable boundary profile.
decision_logic.falsification_pattern: A substantial number of blind controls reproduce FULL_CHAIN at similar frequency, or the target's first-break/boundary profile is not distinguishable from controls.
decision_logic.partial_result: Target is unusual only at one boundary; report that boundary specifically rather than claiming a whole-chain anomaly.
decision_logic.interpretive_rule: Boundary localization outranks aggregate semantic score for causal interpretation.

expected_value.if_confirmed: Provides a reproducible structural signature that can be tested across domains and datasets without relying on the specific Robbie image.
expected_value.if_falsified: Shows that the apparent Robbie/JANUS correspondence is common in visual culture and should be downgraded as a semantic coincidence.
expected_value.regardless_of_outcome: Produces a reusable boundary-localized methodology for distinguishing internal multiplicity from external-world multiplicity.

versioning.next_revision_requires: explicit version bump and changelog; no silent modification of scoring semantics after data collection begins
